description: Search for jobs with filters like titles, locations, companies, skills, salary, and remote options. Returns a list of matching job postings.

companySize.description: Filter by company size (e.g., ["xs" for 1-50, "s" for 50-200, "m" for 200-1K, "l" for 1K-5K, "xl" for 5K+])

dateOffset.description: Only show jobs posted within this time period (e.g., "2D" for last 2 days)

expLevels.description: Experience levels (e.g., ["SE" for Senior, "MI" for Mid-level, "EN" for Entry])

h1bSponsorship.description: Filter for jobs offering H1B sponsorship

industries.description: Filter by company industries (use get_industries to see valid values)

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: 5, max: 50). Keep low to avoid large responses.

locations.description: Locations to search in (e.g., ["San Francisco", "New York", "Remote"])

titles.description: Job titles to search for (e.g., ["Software Engineer", "Senior Developer"]). Max 6 titles.

name: search_jobs
